display_information.name: Alga
display_information.description: Alert management and investigation sync for Alga. Delivers rich alert cards, action buttons, and bidirectional thread sync.

note: To receive inbound DM/MPIM messages, add 'im:history', 'mpim:history', 'im:read', 'mpim:read' to bot scopes and 'message.im', 'message.mpim' to bot_events. The 'im:write' and 'mpim:write' scopes (already included) allow the bot to open DM/MPIM conversations for outbound messages.
